meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 Emacs 中与 AI 对话，无需外部服务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你用 Emacs 并想直接在编辑器里与 AI 交互
copy.tagline_en: Chat with AI inside Emacs, no external service needed
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Emacs and want to interact with AI directly from your editor

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 Emacs 和你对话：你在 Emacs 里发消息或发送 org 文档片段，它会回复到聊天缓冲或作为子标题插入你的文件。
howto.when: 当你在 Emacs 中用快捷键打开聊天缓冲区，或用 org-send 命令发送选中的区域/标题时触发。

say.text: 帮我看下这段代码报错的原因
say.note: 在聊天缓冲区发送后，Claude 直接回复。

say.text: 把这篇 org 笔记整理成行动清单
say.note: 发送 org 后，回答以子标题插入。

say.text: 帮我改写这段会议记录，更正式些
say.note: 选中区域发送，回复就地插入。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can chat with you inside Emacs: send messages or org snippets, and replies appear in a chat buffer or as child headings in your org file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you open the chat buffer with a keybinding, or use the org-send command to send the selected region or heading.

say_en.text: Help me see why this code errors
say_en.note: Sent in chat buffer; reply appears there.

say_en.text: Turn these org notes into an action list
say_en.note: Send org; answer lands as child heading.

say_en.text: Rewrite this meeting note more formally
say_en.note: Send region; reply inserted in place.
